title: Get Cad Working End to End
description: Get CAD working end to end. User ran bun ./📜️script.ts dev cad and got Module not found ./📜️script.ts because root entrypoint is 📜️script.ts. Fix launch.json and CAD playground boot until React CAD playground runs end to end.

Fixed: (1) root script.ts ASCII alias to emoji-prefixed 📜️script.ts so bun ./script.ts works; (2) missing columns catalog icon + non-panicking IconName::from; (3) cad-fixture static-dir root to ✏️s/🔌️plugin/📐️cad/🧫️fixture; (4) FE0E pollution in Rust char literals from concurrent emoji unlock; (5) fixture filename/URL alignment.
